welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.text: This is Mirabelle, your recipe book. Let me show you the basics in half a minute.

home: You’re on the home screen: all your recipes are here.
add: Add recipes from a link to any site, from a photo or by hand. AI sorts out the ingredients and steps for you.
filter: Narrow them down by categories and tags.
sections: Categories and tags live here. Create your own to keep things tidy.
menu: Settings, theme and language. You can always take the tour again from “How to use”.
